query: Which risk factors contribute most to stroke prediction?

documents.name: Stroke
documents.description: PCA shows age and marital status contribute most; residence type none. MLP reaches 75.02% accuracy.
documents.content:
# Predicting Stroke

We analyze patient attributes with PCA. The patient's residence type has no contribution. Age and marital status have the highest contribution to the first two principal components.

Benchmark: the feed-forward multi-layer perceptron achieves 75.02% accuracy over 1000 downsampling experiments.
